home.tagline1: Predict your yield before you run a single batch.
home.tagline2: From host cell selection and engineering through upstream culture to downstream purification, SimBiotix builds a predictive digital twin of your full manufacturing pipeline. Grounded in peer-reviewed biophysics and continuously calibrated with your own lab data, it delivers transparent, uncertainty-aware predictions for titer, viability, productivity, and step yields, so you can identify risks, optimize parameters, and make confident decisions in minutes instead of months.
home.heroFootnote: For research and process development. All outputs are model predictions with explicit uncertainty ranges, never presented as experimental measurements.
home.modulesTitle: One continuous digital twin. Three modules.
home.modulesSubtitle: Every campaign tracks one target molecule across the full pipeline, from genetic design to final purification. Run the connected modules end to end, or isolate a single unit operation.
home.module1Description: Model host cell mechanics and optimize transfection protocols. Score expression potential and developability before thawing a single vial.
home.module2Description: Simulate bioreactor dynamics. Plot viable cell density and titer curves on screen as you tune seeding density, temperature shift, and feed strategy.
home.module3Description: Map your full purification cascade. Model chromatography and filtration steps to predict step-by-step recovery and isolate yield bottlenecks before committing bench time.
home.module3Output: Cumulative yield, mass balance, bottleneck flags
home.painSubtitle: Legacy process-modeling tools assume big-pharma infrastructure and a dedicated computational team. SimBiotix puts predictive biophysics directly in the hands of the wet-lab scientists running mid-market and emerging biotech.
home.pain1Body: Evaluate dozens of protocol permutations in minutes, not months. Screen out low-yield pathways on screen before allocating finite bench space and raw materials.
home.pain2Body: Biophysical models flag volatile parameter combinations and edge-case failures, so you can catch high-risk runs before they reach a pilot batch or a contaminated harvest.
home.pain3Body: No black boxes. Predictions are driven by peer-reviewed biophysical equations, like the Schwan model for electroporation, and continuously calibrated against your own bench data to tighten accuracy over time.
home.loopTitle: Predictions that learn from your bench
home.loopSubtitle: Run a protocol, log the real outcome, and the model recalibrates against your own data. Every campaign tightens the next prediction.
home.loopReturnLabel: Each run calibrates the next prediction
